column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
#   an assertion the manifest lists that the base run never reached counts as failed, by its shortfall
# A base of - means no complete red run was made: none was possible, the
# suite stopped before reached or reached no assertion, or tests/red itself
# was stopped; its stdout said which unless it was the one stopped.
a row said twice is kept once at the count last said, beside the others, and tab-separated
and a different plugin's refusal is reported when it arrives, though the first plugin's were all said
and not at the next stop, which reads the same transcript
nor under a new session id, as the desktop app carries one conversation on, over the same transcript
the count said for a message holding a backslash, brackets and a star is read back exactly
